# T-5: Project review evidence into acceptance

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend existing flow-finding and acceptance ownership to consume typed ADVISORY, exhausted REJECTED, and independent audit evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Handoff entries retain source review step, phase/task, tree SHA, provenance, canonical evidence ref, finding id, and final disposition ownership.
- Acceptance reads the canonical evidence referenced by current flow state and rejects stale, missing, or mismatched evidence.
- Normal existing requirement judgments, repair fingerprint checks, user decisions, and final finding dispositions remain behaviorally covered.

## Implementation Notes
Extend the existing acceptance evidence model rather than creating a second final-judgment subsystem. Keep deferred finding source verification bounded.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local integration tests cover advisory handoff, rejected-at-limit handoff, independent evidence, stale source rejection, and retained acceptance verdicts.
